reason: I already send through my current provider, my sender name is approved there and my list is already loaded. Fifty-odd cents an SMS is about what I pay now, so there is no reason to re-upload everything and wait for a new name approval right before 11.11.
objection: Moving my contact list and getting my business name approved all over again is a hassle, and if the name is not approved in time my sale messages go out wrong or late. I don't know this company and I can't risk a big send failing on sale day.
would_change_my_mind: A clearly lower rate at my volume, say under 0.40 per SMS, plus them importing my list and getting my sender name live for me within a day, with a small test send first.
